I'm a Senior Associate at the [National Center for the Improvement of Educational
Assessment](https://www.nciea.org) (the Center for Assessment). I developed the student growth percentile (SGP)
methodology and maintain the open-source [SGP](https://dbetebenner.github.io/SGP/) R package, which states use to
calculate and report student growth. My work with state education agencies spans growth and accountability
systems, technical advisory committees, and the reporting of results to educators and the public.

## This site

I list my talks from a single catalog built from the original slide files and the Quarto repositories I published
them in. Recent decks stay at their original addresses, because the QR codes on my slides point there.

I built the site with the [dataimago](https://dataimago.ai) design system, with self-hosted fonts and
light and dark themes. If anything here is inaccessible to you, please let me know by
[opening an issue](https://github.com/dbetebenner/dbetebenner.github.io/issues).
